description_en: The ModifyDBConfig operation modifies the dictionary configuration of a community-compatible cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBConfig接口修改社区兼容版集群的字典配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse modify-db-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp1r59y779o040000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the IDs of available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The dictionary configuration items.

The value of the Config parameter overwrites the existing configuration. To delete a dictionary configuration, remove it from the request.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2360627.html operation to query the dictionary configuration of the target instance
parameters.help_zh:
修改字典配置项。

调用接口时会使用请求中的Config覆盖已有的Config配置，因此如果您想删除某个字典配置，可在请求参数中去掉该字典配置。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2360627.html接口查询目标实例的字典Config配置
parameters.name: config
